game_title: Off By One Fixer – Root Tunnels Trial
game_concept: A puzzle set in Mystic Forest – Root Tunnels, tunnels among huge roots: the fairy gardener must handle wasp swarms while practicing control flow: for loops. Core idea – Off By One Fixer: Fix range boundaries that skip or overshoot by one.
theme: Mystic Forest – Root Tunnels: tunnels among huge roots
core_gameplay_loop: In Root Tunnels, repeat each round: Fix range boundaries that skip or overshoot by one. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the fixes value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Reach the elder's door using at most 13 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
win_condition: The elder's door reached with actions_used <= 13.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 13 before the elder's door is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 5 – Control Flow: For Loops | Level 6 (applied tier): Off By One Fixer
